candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Serious errors: changed 「以下」 to 「以上」 in the 2nd and 3rd bullets of ⑦ (the image clearly says 以下); misread furigana 上(のぼ)っている as 上(あ)っている; changed circled numbers ③④… to (3)(4); added furigana not present in image (e.g., 万円(まんえん), 人(ひと), 男女(だんじょ)); underlined phrases not indicated.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Most faithful: circled numbers ③–⑨ preserved, text content and numbers all correct, furigana readings correct (のぼ, す, したまわ, etc.). Minor issues: a few furigana added that are not visible in the image (多(おお)い, 大(おお)きく, 男女(だんじょ)); missing header furigana for 数値/関/説明; underlines from the image not represented.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Very accurate; uses ・ bullets matching the image and circled numbers. Minor omissions: furigana ばあい missing in ⑤⑥ headings, たい missing on に対して in ⑦; underlines not represented; used bold for headers rather than markdown headings but layout is still faithful.

rationale: B and C are both highly accurate transcriptions with all body text and numbers correct. B edges out C because it retains slightly more furigana matching the image (e.g., ばあい in ⑤⑥ headings) and cleaner heading structure, though it adds a few furigana not visible in the scan; C is marginally more conservative (fewer invented furigana) but omits a few furigana that are present. A ranks last due to substantive text errors: it changed 以下 to 以上 in two sentences of section ⑦ (altering meaning), misread the furigana のぼ as あ, replaced circled numbers with parenthesized ones, and invented furigana for words that have none in the image.
